name: Buffy Wicks

items.text: In 2022, anti-abortion groups said AB 2223 would "legalize infanticide." FactCheck.org called that false. An early draft said "perinatal death" without limits. It was amended to cover only deaths from pregnancy-related causes. Wicks called the claim "absurd and disingenuous." Authorities could still investigate evidence of foul play.
items.why: This is a disagreement over how to read a bill she sponsored, with no finding of wrongdoing, so it doesn't bear on any conduct criterion, and her abortion stance is already scored under the platform.

for_review: I searched the owner's sites once with her name and found no pages about her, so owner_sites is empty. I read FactCheck.org and the Senate Judiciary Committee analysis (May 2022 version). I did not open her own tweet or the final enacted text of AB 2223. I also did not check whether the bill passed or was signed. The Senate analysis says the bill deletes the coroner's duty to inquire into deaths following suspected self-induced or criminal abortion. It also says coroner findings on fetal deaths could not be used to support a prosecution. It suggested the author clarify that this doesn't block prosecution when the death wasn't consented to by the mother. A reviewer may want to check whether that clarification was made. I did not look for other controversies about her.
